answer.reason: The verses give John Mark a few distinct events: serving Barnabas and Saul, leaving them at Perga, and the dispute with Paul that led Barnabas to take him to Cyprus.

clauses.english: served as minister to Barnabas and Saul on their journey, preaching at Salamis
clauses.quote: they had also John to their minister

clauses.english: departed from Paul and his company at Perga and returned to Jerusalem
clauses.quote: John departing from them returned to Jerusalem

clauses.english: was taken by Barnabas to Cyprus after a sharp contention with Paul over him
clauses.quote: so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus

doubts: ACT 12:25 and ACT 12:12, COL 4:10 are already in the summary, so they were not used as clauses.
Later mentions (2TI 4:11, PHM 1:24, 1PE 5:13) only name or salute Mark, or ask for him, so they were left out.
